projects.name: GraphShield
projects.description: Real-Data Graph ML for Financial Fraud Detection
highlights: Built a leakage-safe graph ML research pipeline on DGraphFin with 3.7M nodes, 4.3M edges, 17 node features, and official supervised splits of 857,899 train, 183,862 validation, and 183,840 test nodes
Implemented GraphShield, a dual-path spectral GNN with low-pass and high-pass graph filters, and evaluated it against GraphSAGE, logistic regression, XGBoost, and prior baselines
Ran 6-seed real-data ablations showing GraphShield reached 0.0415 AUC-PR and 0.7748 AUC-ROC
Added paired-bootstrap testing with 300 resamples, held-out conformal calibration, temporal/OOD drift diagnostics, and research-contract tests

projects.name: IPL Analytics Platform
highlights: Engineered a 3-stage IPL data pipeline over 278,205 ball-by-ball records from 18 seasons, producing a feature parquet plus 18 aggregate parquet datasets for fast analytics
Built a 15-page Streamlit app backed by 19 DuckDB views, including player, team, venue, matchup, phase, records, tournament, and match-level analysis for 1,169 IPL matches

Implemented a deterministic semantic search engine that compiles supported cricket questions into whitelisted SQL, ships with 40 example prompts, and exposes assumptions plus generated SQL instead of guessing unsupported requests
Added a schema-driven per-visual control system and expanded regression coverage to 52 pytest checks to keep interactive filters and statistics aligned across the analytics pages
